title: Cold rebuild: Subresource Integrity
summary: Rebuild MatchesIntegrity from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **MatchesIntegrity** in *Integrity: lock files, SBOMs, signatures and SRI*. Write it again from an
**empty editor**. The tests are the ones you passed: the strongest algorithm wins, options are ignored, bad input is false.
If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again tomorrow. This check, plus the boss, proves the module.

steps.prompt: An `integrity` attribute lists a `sha256` and a `sha512` token. Which does the browser check?
options: Only the sha512 token(s): the strongest algorithm present

steps.title: Rebuild MatchesIntegrity cold
prompt: Write `bool MatchesIntegrity(byte[] content, string integrity)`: space-separated `alg-Base64` tokens (options after `?` ignored), only the strongest of sha256 < sha384 < sha512 counts, any of those may match, unknown algorithms are ignored, and no usable token or bad Base64 means false. Compare in constant time. `using System.Security.Cryptography;`.
